exemplars.title: Public inner-loop workspace replay exemplar

workspace_posture.dominant_use: repeated local build/test/check loops with CI-adjacent replay
workspace_posture.target_posture: single dominant host target with optional nightly comparison

comparison_invariants: workspace membership remains stable during comparison window
dominant target triple remains fixed unless comparison is explicitly target-aware
build command family and capture posture stay visible
allowed_variation: stable vs nightly comparison when declared
editor-adjacent consumers may be present or absent
timing or rebuild attachment family may vary
exemplars.public_twin_strategy: public workspace is the canonical proving world; no private twin is required for baseline claims
notes: Best first proving terrain for Build-State Evidence and shared-spine validation.
A tiny one-crate demo should not be substituted for this class.

exemplars.title: Public release-boundary library replay exemplar

workspace_posture.shape: publishable crate or small library family
workspace_posture.target_posture: stable release posture with docs.rs relevance

comparison_invariants: subject crate or library-family identity remains explicit
public-boundary intent remains the same across compared runs
docs or semantic import lane remains named
allowed_variation: docs.rs vs local rustdoc JSON import lane
exemplars.public_twin_strategy: public exemplar is primary; optional private downstream twin may exist but must not silently replace the public release-boundary card
notes: Primary proving terrain for Migration/Public API and Compatibility Claims.
Especially useful for pack vs diff vs verify discipline.

exemplars.title: Restricted-intake shadow exemplar lane

workspace_posture.shape: consumer workspace with real package intake controls
workspace_posture.target_posture: stable intake path after explicit review

comparison_invariants: route or source-policy posture remains explicit
allowed_variation: mirror vs registry vs vendored route families
exemplars.public_twin_strategy: publish the exemplar card, invariants, and redacted public artifact family; run deeper route/payload checks on a private shadow twin when necessary
notes: This card exists to avoid the false choice between fully public and fully folkloric security/intake evidence.
The public card should still describe what remains unshareable.

exemplars.title: Public native-edge polyglot boundary replay exemplar

workspace_posture.shape: polyglot workspace with a real Rust/native boundary
workspace_posture.dominant_use: provider, linker, build-script, or binding handoff comparison

comparison_invariants: host-vs-target posture does not silently drift
allowed_variation: foreign language or build system family
exemplars.public_twin_strategy: public exemplar is expected; private twin is optional for vendor-specific SDK cases but must preserve the same boundary card and invariants
notes: Primary proving terrain for Native Edge and polyglot boundary work.
Avoid pure-Rust stand-ins that erase the actual foreign-build seam.

exemplars.title: Cross-target docs and consumer-routing replay exemplar

workspace_posture.dominant_use: target-aware docs imports and routed consumer handoffs
workspace_posture.target_posture: docs.rs default target plus one declared comparison target

comparison_invariants: subject package and version family remain explicit
consumer class or routing class remains named
primary docs or semantic import lane remains visible
allowed_variation: docs.rs vs local docs build source
exemplars.public_twin_strategy: public exemplar is primary; consumer-specific private twins may exist for support or enterprise routing but must keep the same target-drift contract
notes: Primary proving terrain for target-aware docs and assistant-safe routed briefs.
Especially useful after docs.rs target-default changes.
